title: gh issue view ${number} --json ${fields} --jq ${filter}
description: One issue, ${fields} one of assignees, state, or title, which kit reads in `modules/bash/forge/github.sh` (forge/github:issue-assignees, forge/github:issue-state, forge/github:issue-title), which `modules/bash/tracker/forge.sh` (tracker/forge:assignees, tracker/forge:state, tracker/forge:title) reaches through the forge. The types are the Issue object of GitHub's GraphQL schema, https://docs.github.com/public/fpt/schema.docs.graphql, as gh renders its fields (https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/trunk/api/export_pr.go), assignees as a plain list.

User.description: A user as gh renders one: id, login, name, and databaseId
